contribution.position: I hold my earlier position. Product says reliability is settled because nobody else raised it, but agreement is not evidence. The only reliability artifact in the set is artifact:incident-log, and it shows a 2.1% 30-day error rate against a 0.5% SLO (about 4x the budget) and two sev2 incidents. That points away from settled. QA says risk is contained on the strength of 412 passed and 0 failed, but artifact:test-report measures functional correctness and coverage. It does not measure production error behavior, so it cannot show the change leaves the 2.1% unchanged or improves it. No artifact in the list covers three things: the sev2 root causes, how much of the 2.1% comes from paths this change touches, and any expected or measured effect of the change on the error rate. These gaps are named, not assumed closed. The ops runbook (artifact:ops-runbook) covers rollback, which limits the impact of a bad outcome but does not show the reliability gap is addressed. Evidence that would move me: sev2 postmortems with root-cause status, an error breakdown by code path, and a pre/post or canary error-rate comparison.
